data.name: Adidev
data.gender_notes: Adidev is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from 'Adi', meaning primordial or beginning, and 'Dev', meaning god. In Hindu mythology, Adidev represents the supreme being, the creator of the universe. The name Adidev carries the meaning “Godlike, Supreme Being” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Adidev usually hope their child will grow to embody godlike, supreme being and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A connection to the divine, embodying the qualities of creation, power, and wisdom.
data.etymology: Adidev belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Godlike, Supreme Being.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Adidev total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Adidev" holds immense cultural significance in Hinduism, which is one of the oldest religions in the world. It reflects the deep respect and devotion towards the divine and the belief in a supreme entity that governs the universe's creation and sustenance. Hindu mythology is rich with various gods and goddesses, and Adidev, the primordial god, symbolizes the concept of the ultimate creator, reminding us of the cyclic nature of the universe and the interconnectedness of all things.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, the name "Adidev" emphasizes our connection to the divine and the cosmic awareness that we are all part of this vast creation. It encourages us to look beyond ourselves and recognize our place in the grand scheme of things. By invoking the name "Adidev," we pay homage to the supreme deity, who is the embodiment of divine wisdom, purity, and power. It serves as a reminder to live our lives with devotion, humility, and compassion, and to strive towards enlightenment and spiritual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Adidev is a title given to the supreme deity in Hinduism, representing the ultimate divine power and creator of the universe. It symbolizes the absolute truth and infinite wisdom, beyond the reach of human comprehension.
